Here’s the truth

It’s not you. It’s the prompt.

Ordinary AI prompts were never made for tracing pages. Traceable pictures for children follow rules nobody tells you: one clear subject, thick clean outlines, simple shapes and lots of white space. Unless your prompt is built for exactly that, every attempt is a guess.

Good to know

Questions, answered.

What is included in Doodopia?

A master image creator prompt, 330 original developmental prompts, 500+ themed prompts, seven practical image-making techniques, an image quality guide, and the included Trace & Color Maker software. You also get 3 free bonuses: the 100 Kids Worksheet Idea Vault, 50 Premium Book Cover Creator Prompts, and The Digital Worksheet Selling Blueprint.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes. You’re covered by a 7-day money-back guarantee. If Doodopia isn’t right for you, contact us within 7 days of your purchase and we’ll refund your full $65.

Do the bonuses cost extra?

No. All three bonuses are included free with the $65 Doodopia Complete Creator System. There’s nothing else to buy.

Do I need experience with AI image tools?

No advanced experience is needed to follow the guides. You will need access to a compatible AI image-generation service of your choice; that service is separate from Doodopia.

Is the tracing software included?

Yes. Trace & Color Maker is included for unlimited use. Add your colored image, review the tracing result, and download it for printing.

Does Doodopia guarantee sales or ready-to-publish artwork?

No. Image results vary and need your review. The marketplace screenshots on this page show competitor listings, not Doodopia sales, and are not a promise of earnings.

Can I sell work made with these prompts?

Check the commercial-use terms for your chosen image-generation service and the rules of the marketplace where you plan to publish. Your permissions depend on those terms and on the images you create.

Is an AI image-generation subscription included?

No. Doodopia provides prompts and guidance. Any image-generation service you use is separate. Trace & Color Maker is included for unlimited use.
